title: Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Race Was Like
seo_title: Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon 2026 Review: Weather, Field, Times
meta_description: Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon 2026 review: an overcast, drizzly 25°C morning in Palayan City, 43 marathon finishers, and a half marathon far slower than in 2025.
dek: What the 2026 Trailblaze race in Palayan City was like to run: a grey, damp race morning, a small first marathon field, and how the half marathon and 10 km compared with the 2025 edition.
verdict: Enter if you want a small provincial race in Palayan City with mild, cloudy conditions and a realistic chance of placing. The 2026 edition added a marathon, which 43 runners finished, half of them after 5 hours 35 minutes. Race morning stayed at about 25°C to 27°C under full cloud and drizzle. The half marathon was much slower and smaller than in 2025, with the median 21 minutes slower and fewer than half as many finishers, while the 10 km barely changed. No course was published, so ask the organiser about the route.

sections.heading: The Race: From a Half Marathon to a Marathon
paragraphs: The 2026 race was held in Palayan City, Nueva Ecija, on Sunday 30 August, with 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races, and is organised by Team Nueva Ecija Runners [1][2]. It grew out of the Trailblaze Half Marathon, which the same organiser held at Palayan City Park on Sunday 7 September 2025 over 21 km, 10 km and 5 km [2][3].

The 2025 edition was billed with the theme "River Roots, Runner's Route" and promoted as a scenic course [3], but no route map, elevation profile, start times or cut-offs were published with the 2026 results [1]. Ask the organiser for the route before race day.

sections.heading: The Weather: Grey, Damp and Mild
paragraphs: Open-Meteo's modelled hourly weather for Palayan City shows an overcast, drizzly race morning. From 4am to 6am it was about 25°C with a dew point of 24°C, 92% to 95% humidity, a breeze of about 10 km/h and light rain of under 1 mm an hour. Full cloud held all morning, and it warmed only slowly: 25.7°C at 7am, 26.2°C at 8am, 26.9°C at 9am and 27.9°C at 10am [4].

For late August in Central Luzon, that is kind running weather: no sun to speak of and little heat build-up for slower marathoners. The air is close to saturated, though, so effort still feels harder than the temperature suggests. The 2025 race morning was about 2°C cooler before dawn, 22.8°C at 4am, and also overcast and dry [5].

sections.heading: Cut-offs and Finishing Times
paragraphs: No cut-off times were published with the results. The slowest recorded finishes in 2026 were 6:30:42 in the marathon, 3:49:56 in the half marathon and 2:06:10 in the 10 km [1].

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: Forty-three runners finished the first marathon. Two broke four hours, in 3:35:57 and 3:43:35, and tenth place was 4:52:01. Twelve finishers (28%) came in under five hours; the median was 5:34:57 and the 90th percentile 6:16:28. Five of the finishers were women, the fastest in 4:17:57 [1].

The half marathon had 121 finishers, with a top ten from 1:38:23 to 2:05:45. The median was 2:37:55 and the 90th percentile 3:13:37; eight runners (7%) broke two hours and 45 (37%) broke 2:30. Women made up 16% of the field [1].

That is a big change from 2025, when 282 runners finished the half, the top ten ran from 1:17:26 to 1:37:21, the median was 2:17:00 and 67% broke 2:30 [2]. The 10 km, by contrast, barely moved: 306 finishers against 357, a median of 1:19:33 against 1:20:44, and 13% under an hour in both years [1][2]. Since the 10 km times held steady, the slower half marathon more likely reflects a different or harder half-marathon route, or faster runners moving up to the new marathon, than the weather. The organiser did not publish either course, so this cannot be confirmed.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a small, friendly provincial race and a real chance of a high finish: in 2026 a marathon under 4:52 made the top ten, a half marathon under 2:06 did the same, and the overcast morning was kind to slower runners.

Think twice if you want a published, measured course or a big field. In the marathon you will run much of the way alone, and the half-marathon results suggest the route may change from year to year. Confirm the course, start times and any cut-off with the organiser before entering.
Nobody from this site ran the race. This review draws on the official results for 2026 and 2025, an event listing for the 2025 race and modelled historical weather.

faqs.question: What was the weather like at the 2026 Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon?
faqs.answer: Mild, grey and damp. Modelled weather for Palayan City on 30 August 2026 gave about 25°C and 92% to 95% humidity from 4am to 6am, with light drizzle, a 10 km/h breeze and full cloud. It reached only 26°C by 8am and 28°C by 10am, which spared slower marathoners the usual late-morning heat.

faqs.question: How fast is the field at the Trailblaze Nueva Ecija Marathon?
faqs.answer: Small and spread out. In 2026, 43 runners finished the marathon, with tenth place in 4:52:01 and a median of 5:34:57. The half marathon had 121 finishers, a top ten down to 2:05:45 and a median of 2:37:55. In the 10 km, 306 finished and the median was 1:19:33.

faqs.question: How did the 2026 Trailblaze race compare with 2025?
faqs.answer: The half marathon shrank and slowed. Finishers fell from 282 in 2025 to 121 in 2026, the median slowed from 2:17:00 to 2:37:55, and the share under 2:30 dropped from 67% to 37%. The 10 km barely changed, with a median of about 1:20 both years. The 2026 edition also added a marathon.

editorial_notes: Reinstated 2026-11-06: official results for the 30 August 2026 edition (MyRunTime) confirm it ran, so the review was rewritten to the template about that edition, with year-over-year comparison to the 2025 Trailblaze Half Marathon. Same series: both MyRunTime results pages list Palayan City and the same Team Nueva Ecija Runners Facebook page, and the 2025 listing names Palayan City Park. Neither year's course was published, so the half-marathon slowdown cannot be attributed; the comparison assumes comparable courses only for the 10 km. MyRunTime gives no clock times, so start times were not derived. Weather is Open-Meteo modelled hourly data for Palayan City; no nearby station is in the Iowa Environmental Mesonet METAR archive (Clark is about 50 km away). Runners are not named. No rating.
